newsitem.title: USA: Maxim starts Phase III trial of cancer drug.
newsitem.headline: Maxim starts Phase III trial of cancer drug.

text.p: Maxim Pharmaceuticals Inc said it has initiated a Phase III clinical trial in the United States of its drug Maxamine for the treatment of advanced-stage malignant melanoma patients.

In the clinical trial, advanced-stage malignant melanoma patients will be treated with a coadministration of Maxamine and interleukin-2 (IL-2). Patients in the control group will be treated with IL-2 alone.
The study is designed to determine overall patient survival, and time to progression, tumor response, duration of response and quality of life, the company said.
The study will be conducted in 15 or more centers in the United States.

Maxamine is being developed as an adjuvant to cytokine therapy for the treatment of cancer and infectious diseases. Previous European clinical studies of Maxamine in malignant melanoma have shown improved survival outcomes and improved quality of life, the company said.
